reviewCharts.warning: Oregon vote-share review rows are loaded from the official federal precinct workbook where precinct-level presidential candidate totals are published. Many county sheets publish only countywide presidential totals with zero precinct rows, so those counties remain unavailable for local advisory indicators. No same-row down-ballot comparison is mapped yet.
